incidents.cause: The pilot’s failure to maintain clearance from the water while maneuvering in low visibility conditions due to smoke and haze.
The pilot's inability to maintain directional control while landing on a slush-covered runway due to inadequate maintenance of the airplane brakes by maintenance personnel.
A loose oil line, which allowed oil to leak onto the hot engine turbocharger and resulted in a fire.
The seizure of the propeller gearbox for reasons that could not be determined based on the available information, which resulted in a forced landing.
The student pilot's failure to maintain directional control on landing.
The pilot’s failure to maintain directional control during landing, which resulted in a ground loop.
